purpose_vi: Tạo ảnh và video thật cho đúng các cảnh trong batch này. Không viết lại script. Không tạo voice, phụ đề, nhạc hoặc bản dựng tập cuối.
execution_order: For each scene: check checkpoint and actual files -> attach references -> generate one still -> inspect still -> save/hash/checkpoint -> generate one 10-second image-to-video from that still -> save raw -> strip audio with stream copy -> inspect -> save/hash/checkpoint. Only then proceed to next scene.

service_policy.provider: Muse built-in image and image-to-video tools; signed-in Chrome px75 account
service_policy.transient_retry: Poll/download any unresolved job; do not resubmit. A confirmed terminal generation failure or saved visual QA rejection may use the bounded retry policy. Retrieval-only retries do not spend generation calls.
service_policy.global_blocker: Stop submitting new media calls, persist and publish partial output, mark remaining work blocked, and report the exact service error. No unsolicited recurring schedule.
service_policy.repair_rule: At most one extra call per rejected/terminally failed stage, shared production budget of 12 extra calls. Prepare retry explicitly with checkpoint.py retry. Never recreate approved images or videos; preserve rejected files with versioned replacement paths.
service_policy.message_limit: A per-message tool/image cap is a turn boundary, not a permanent scene/account failure. Save the current job and checkpoint, package partial output and state the exact next work unit. Never mark untouched scenes blocked for a per-message cap.

checkpoint.durability: Write after each image, generation job submission, downloaded video, QA result and failure. Retain image if video fails; never restart the batch from scene one.

include: raw video if space permits, otherwise separate archive
